pages.title: Brass
pages.text:
A steampunk alloy of copper and zinc.

- **Tier:** Iron
- **Durability:** 300
- **Sword damage:** 6
- **Armor (full set):** 15

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text: In the [Alloy Forge](entry://alloy_forge/alloy_forge), 3 copper ingots and 1 zinc ingot make 4 Brass Ingots.

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text: - **Momentum:** each hit in a quick combo with a brass weapon attacks faster, up to 3 stacks. The combo ends 3 seconds after the last hit.

pages.title: Clockwork
pages.text:
**Full set bonus.** Walking, hitting, and blocking wind up a **spring** (shown above the hotbar). About 30 seconds of walking winds it fully; hits and blocks wind it faster. A fully wound spring gives Haste.

**Spring Release (R):** with a fully wound spring, dash forward and hit every mob in front of you for 6 damage, knocking them back. This lets the spring go.
